why: Gives builders a concrete place to start. Unblocked now that conformance is the spec itself (CZ-4); the reference firmware is the first entry.
Mostly written already in docs/comparison.md and the README graphic; this gathers it into one docs page, so it is cheap.
The audience is settled (CZ-23) and bare metal is written down (CZ-18), so the principles can now be drawn from what the spec already says.
Needed before calling the standard 1.0, but with one maintainer nothing waits on it yet.
Matters once other builders use the name. HDMI wording is settled (CZ-25); this covers the CoCo Zero name itself.
May end up as nothing: the spec carries only hard limits. One question for the user, whether a maximum height belongs in it.
Newcomers are in the audience (CZ-23: anyone curious enough to spend $20), so this is worth writing; it comes last because it explains terms the other pages settle.
